# phone-window

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: Open phone window: a row in the action bar's view-options popover that opens this page (the same URL, the same browser session) in a pop-up window sized like a phone (the Phone device size), with no address bar — a real narrow window, so the app takes its phone layout. Developer-only; never shown inside the phone window itself.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `ActionBar.ViewOption` → `OpenPhoneWindowRow`
  - Uses:
    - `primitives/css/control-panel.ControlPanel`
    - `primitives/dom/render-mode.useBrowserValue`
    - `shell/action-bar.ActionBar`
    - `ui/icons.Icon`
